login.headline: Your books are where you left them.
login.aside: Every conversation is saved, down to the last page Zaydoun cited.
login.title: Welcome back
login.subtitle: Log in to your library.
login.deactivatedBody: An admin turned it off. If you think that’s a mistake, <link>contact us</link>.

register.headline: Bring a book. He’s already curious.
register.step2: Zaydoun reads it, page by page
register.title: Create your account
register.subtitle: Free to start. No card needed.
register.name: Full name

forgot.title: Forgot your password?
forgot.intro: Enter your email and we’ll send you a link to set a new one.
forgot.sentBody: If an account exists for <email>{address}</email>, a reset link is on its way. It works for one hour.
forgot.resend: Nothing after a few minutes? Check spam, or <button>send it again</button>.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.expiredBody: Reset links expire after an hour and can only be used once. Ask for a fresh one and use it right away.
reset.doneBody: You’re all set. Log in with your new password. For safety, you’ve been signed out on your other devices.
